description_ru: Современный отдел. Аллювиальные отложения пойменных террас. Супеси, пески, суглинки
note: GGK-200 N-44-XX (Geologicheskaya karta SSSR, 1st edition, approved 1956, printed 1957; Kulunda plain, Burla valley, 79-80E 53d20m-54dN), Quaternary map; RASTER = geokniga 2000x2286 px PREVIEW (~35 m/px); vertical lithology ruling removed (work/r200d/prep_vlines.py); tints calibrated on the map (preview_tint_calib.py); eolQ2+Q3 (ridge sands, dot stipple) and eol+dQ2+Q3 (eolian-deluvial loess-like cover, ruling) print one base tint (3.6 dE, 59-90 % ambiguous): one class E (hclass2 C) (PI decision 2026-10-04: loess-like cover = E); the lake deposits lQ4 print in the lake tint (legend swatch 3 dE from it, ~1 % of the face): read as WATER; frame = 4 corners (paper edge and ridge filter agree); no interior graticule is printed (the one crossing gratties found is a ruling line: not used)
